periods.label: Regressed Rasputina / China

name.jp: チーナ / ラスプーチナ

periods.occupation: former criminal; child under Kinji’s care; nursery child
periods.affiliation: Kinji household; Child Nursery Tamachi; later Lectea treatment party

status.condition: regressed to around age 5-6; lethal hour syndrome treated by departure to Lectea

periods.summary: Rasputina is subjected to Livia's time-folding curse and becomes a small girl called China. She bonds with Kinji as father, attends nursery, suffers chronic lethal hour syndrome, is possessed by ancestor Gedronika, then departs through Livia’s water transfer to Lectea for Wieseliv’s treatment.

kinji.summary: clings to him, calls him papa at farewell

aria.summary: accepts Aria as one of Kinji's companions but gets jealous

livia.summary: Livia regresses her, then escorts her to treatment

gedronika.summary: dragon ancestor uses her body as coordinate and possession vessel

angelica-starr.summary: Angelica initially seeks custody but helps save her

key_events.summary: appears at Kasai as a regressed child after Livia's interrupted curse
attends nursery and struggles with peer conflict and bento culture
says farewell to Kinji and travels via water transfer toward Lectea treatment

titles: 金次名义上的女儿/被监护人
periods.affiliation: 远山金次监护；曾受韦泽尔芙治疗

status.physical: 存在劣化症候群被韦泽尔芙治愈，年龄体感稍增长
status.social: 由韦泽尔芙只交还给正式监护人金次
status.mental: 天真黏人，回归后迅速适应新照料者

appearance.overview: 五岁半左右，金色刘海，穿雷克提亚材料嫩草色迷你连衣裙。

kinji.summary: 称金次为金驰，被他从台北101顶端接回。

vezeluv.summary: 被其治疗并护送回此世界。

cocoa-machine.summary: 在金次被管束和返日前由机娘照顾。

monkey.summary: 在台北酒店陪她吃豆花。

carbuncle.summary: 被卡邦克鲁抱着躲过警方冲突。

periods.summary: 千奈的存在劣化症候群被韦泽尔芙治愈后，在台北101顶端由金次接回。她因航班与震灾滞留台北，由机娘、猴和卡邦克鲁临时照看。

key_events.summary: 从韦泽尔芙背后扑向金次，宣告自己回来了。
